text:
Aj Chen: Heads up — AcmeDynamics sent their security questionnaire and asked for a short POC next week. They want a capability matrix + written answers for KMS/HSM, VPC peering, and data residency. I uploaded the questionnaire: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-sales/acmedyn/sec-questionnaire.pdf. Need security wording and pricing.

Marta Lopez: On it. Thinking a 3-day POC: day 1 ingest & onboarding, day 2 perf + embeddings validation, day 3 biz handoff + runbook. cc @Diane R. for pricing.

Diane R.: For POC we can offer $3k credits + a potential $1k infra stipend if they need on-prem trial hardware. If they fast-track Dedicated commit within 60 days we can include a 30% discount for first 3 months. Need expected QPS/embedding volume to firm numbers.

Aj Chen: They gave rough numbers: ~100 concurrent chat sessions peak, ~5k embedding requests/day, average prompt length ~300 tokens. Also explicitly asked whether we support customer-managed HSM + on-prem deployments for regulated data.

Vikram Patel: Security note: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM integrations; Private deployment supports PKCS#11 HSMs and on-prem KMS. FedRAMP is not in our current offering; we should say that and offer compensating controls. I'll prepare exact language for the questionnaire. Pen test window required (typically 2 weeks).

Marta Lopez: I'll draft the capability matrix. Proposed columns: Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private | Notes. Rows: multi-tenant isolation, per-tenant KMS, VPC peering, throughput SLOs, retention/SOC controls, on-prem package.

Aj Chen: I uploaded a sample POC runbook and the customer's questionnaire to the shared folder: s3://redwood-sales/acmedyn/poc-runbook.pdf and s3://redwood-sales/acmedyn/sec-questionnaire.pdf.

Claire (deploy-bot): Calendar: POC kickoff scheduled 2026-04-28 10:00 PDT — invitation sent to acme-dynamics@acme.com and the team.

Vikram Patel: Draft answer for checkbox Q1: "Do you support customer-managed keys?" -> "Yes. Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and customer HSMs (PKCS#11). Data at rest is encrypted with per-tenant keys; key rotation and audit logs available. For Hosted API customers may request dedicated encryption controls under an enterprise contract." I'll paste final copy in the folder.

Diane R.: For pricing we need to confirm whether they will use Dedicated or Private for the POC. If Private -> additional on-prem kit costs may apply. Also need a list of expected token volume for cost estimate.

Marta Lopez: Quick ask for the capability matrix: can someone confirm the Dedicated baseline SLO? I recall 99.9% uptime and median p50 gen latency targets per model vary. I'll mark as TBD and add model-specific notes.

Aj Chen: Finance already approved the POC credits. Legal: NDA + DPA required before we start ingestion. Can someone ping legal? @Diane R. will route.

Vikram Patel: Also note: if they request HSM key import/export, we need to state limitations: typically we accept key import for BYOK into customer HSMs, but not export of private key material from HSM.

Marta Lopez: Small deliverable: will add an "Evaluation checklist" and a minimal prompt set + eval harness. Example eval curl for embeddings:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```

Marta Lopez: I'll push the matrix and the draft written answers by EOD today to s3://redwood-sales/acmedyn/deliverables/.

Diane R.: Approving on our side for credits and discount path. Please include a short addendum in the quote for the $1k infra stipend if they require on-site testing.

Claire (deploy-bot): Reminder: attach final questionnaire file to the customer workspace: redwood-sec-questionnaire-acmedyn-final.pdf (uploaded).

Aj Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer with the proposed POC dates and next steps. Will post the legal contact for NDA once Diane confirms. :thumbsup:

Vikram Patel: Uploaded sec answers and notes. FYI: pen-test scheduling may shift the start by ~2 weeks if they insist on full pen test before ingestion.

Marta Lopez: Draft pushed: s3://redwood-sales/acmedyn/deliverables/capability-matrix-v1.xlsx and sec-answers-v1.md. Please review.

Aj Chen: Reviewing now. If no objections I'll send to AcmeDynamics this afternoon.

Diane R.: No objections from finance. Go ahead. :white_check_mark:
